description: Archived Experiment 04 protocol and execution environment. Documents source-defined settings; not a runtime override.

protocol.ranking: Frozen D0 selector; descending bounded std or exact nearest-D0 distance; independent tie/random streams; no future safety filtering
protocol.distance: Euclidean [theta/1,omega/3], nearest among all 20000 D0 pre-action states
protocol.collection: First negative raw next-state margin stops episode; crossing transition counts; next candidate in frozen rank; complete stream prefixes
protocol.collection_failure: Fatal, preserve partial log; no easier replacement or silent exclusion
protocol.budget_cutoff: Not an MDP terminal; separate flag; whole prefix episode remains eligible for bootstrap
protocol.training_seeds: Independent selector/retraining streams; identical retraining member streams across strategies and budgets
protocol.bootstrap: N draws of whole episodes with replacement; ragged flatten; transition-mean MSE; whole-episode OOB
protocol.deployment: Mean of five individually clipped member torques; population std; preserve raw outputs
protocol.safety: Shared safety_margin on raw env.unwrapped.state, including all 201 visited states; no plotting clips or angle wrapping for safety
protocol.policy_state: Shared get_state(observation), canonical angle; same convention as D0/03
protocol.full_study_summary: Paired seed differences, mean/sample-SD/min/max and 10000 seed-bootstrap 95% intervals; no pilot inferential claims
protocol.coverage: Save exact nearest-D0 distance for every new s_t and s_(t+1), plus per-budget distributions and initial-state distances separately
protocol.leakage_control: Selection sees D0 and pool only; training sees selected prefixes only; evaluation ICs and labels never passed to either
protocol.training_default_seed_is_overridden: Actual master-derived selector/retraining seeds and member streams are saved per seed.

inference.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of bootstrapped paired mean differences
inference.standard_deviation: sample SD, ddof=1, of per-seed differences
inference.conditioning: Fixed shared evaluation ICs; intervals describe training/acquisition seed variation, not test-population uncertainty
inference.multiplicity: Separate marginal intervals for two primary outcomes; secondary analyses descriptive, no familywise adjustment

diagnostic_only_additions.tail: Largest ceil(5%*N) distances, tail mean and share of total distance
diagnostic_only_additions.settling: First observed suffix entirely within radius .05; no inference about censored continuation
diagnostic_only_additions.weighting: Report both transition-weighted and equally weighted trajectory diagnostics
diagnostic_only_additions.bin_interpretation: Resolution-dependent occupancy, not continuous covered volume

protocol.replay_policy: Pilot established deterministic equivalence. Full study does not repeat acquisition; physical executed expert collection steps equal maximum budget per strategy.
protocol.PD_reference: One shared deterministic evaluation on identical fixed held-out ICs, reused across seeds.

execution.multiprocessing: spawn; each worker uses deterministic single-thread CPU PyTorch
